text:
Hi there, and thank you for reaching out to Leafy! I'm sorry about the out-of-stock news on your fern. That's disappointing, especially when you were looking forward to it.

Good news: you don't need to do anything. When we email about an out-of-stock item, the customer has 3 days to reply. If there's no reply within 3 days, the item is **automatically refunded**. Since it's been 4 days since our email, that window has passed, so your fern should be refunded automatically.

A few things to know about the refund:

- **Where it goes:** back to your original payment method.
- **How long it takes once issued:** 5-10 business days for cards, or 3-5 business days for digital wallets.
- **Only that item:** the refund covers the fern itself. If you had other items in the order, those would carry on as normal.

I can't see your order or refund status from here, so if you don't see the refund on your statement after the timeframe above, please reach out with your order number (it looks like LF- followed by six digits) and we'll look into it. Please don't send a full card number or security code. If we need to verify a payment, the last four digits are enough.

If you'd still love a fern, you're welcome to place a new order for one. I can't promise it will be back in stock, but it's worth checking the website.

Is there anything else I can help you with? Happy planting!
